properties.description:
An Artifact GOVERNED_BY a methodology DesignRule with no outgoing CAUSES edge is reported by detect_defects as `untriaged_report`, at info severity. It answers the question a triage rule cannot answer about itself: was this document actually read, or merely filed?

THE PREDICATE IS TYPED, NOT TEXTUAL — no id substring, no path prefix — so it works on any project rather than on one whose folders happen to be named `feedback`. Measured on reflow2 2026-09-09: the typed predicate selects four Artifacts, all field reports; dropping the category term selects thirty-one nodes of eight types.

PARKING DOES NOT SUPPRESS IT, deliberately: registering a dated report is what parks it, so a detector honouring parking would report zero on every graph that has any reports at all — and a detector reporting zero because it had nothing to run on reads exactly like one that ran clean. The rule population is reported for the same reason.
properties.name: A registered report that produced no finding is reported, and never blocks
